sio2_quenching.name: Quenching of SiO2 - Level 3
sio2_quenching.description: Simulate the quenching process of alpha quartz SiO2. Use the reaxff potential. Ensure charge equilibration is included using fix qeq/reaxff, compatible with reaxff. Detect the glass transition temperature (Tg) during cooling. Report the Tg value in Kelvin.
